references.text: Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath are mentioned as cities in the territory of the tribe of Naphtali in the distribution of the land.
The entire passage describes the inheritance of Naphtali, including the cities mentioned in Judges 1:33.
The same pattern where the Israelites did not drive out the Canaanites but subjected them to forced labor, as described for Manasseh.
Parallel examples showing that Ephraim and Zebulun also did not drive out the Canaanites but made them forced laborers.
Asher followed the same pattern and lived among the Canaanites instead of driving them out.
The same theme: The tribe of Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants but subjected them to forced labor when Israel became strong.
